lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal phase ErAgTe₂ (space group I-4m2, No. 119) has a unit cell containing 16 atoms—4 Er, 4 Ag, and 8 Te—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Er centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 Te neighbors, Ag centers with 8 Te neighbors, and Te centers with 9 neighbors (2 Ag, 4 Er, 3 Te). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Te 9-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Ag 8-vertex and Er 12-vertex polyhedra.
